speaker: Host
text: Welcome back to the show. Today I have two guests with me, and we are testing how a three-way conversation sounds.

speaker: Guest
text: Thanks for having me, Carter. I have been looking forward to this for weeks.

speaker: Guest2
text: Same here. It is not often that we get to disagree with each other on air.

speaker: Host
text: Let us start simple. What is the one idea from this month's reading that stuck with you?

speaker: Guest2
text: For me it was the claim that small rules, repeated often enough, end up shaping a whole city.

speaker: Guest
text: I would push back on that a little. Rules matter, but people bend them all the time, and the bending is where the real story is.

speaker: Host
text: So you think the exceptions matter more than the rules?

speaker: Guest
text: In practice, yes. Nobody lives inside a rulebook.

speaker: Guest2
text: But the rulebook decides what counts as an exception in the first place. That is my whole point.

speaker: Host
text: That is a good place to pause. We will come back to it after a short break. Stay with us.
